name: SHEIN
h1: A newly listed SHEIN, running on connected work
lede: SHEIN is listing in Hong Kong, absorbing a tariff shock in the US and adding Everlane to the group. Airtable gives the teams carrying that change one connected view of the programs behind it.
why_h2: Listing, tariffs and acquisitions, all at once
why_p: A public listing, a shift in market mix and a new brand to integrate each add cross-functional work that has to be coordinated and reported on.

signals.title: Q1 loss as US tariffs bite
signals.body: SHEIN's draft prospectus showed a US$99 million loss for the three months to March 2026, with US revenue down 14.3% after the removal of the de minimis exemption.
signals.angle: Shifting supply and market mix quickly needs one view of the programs, owners and decisions involved.

signals.title: Hong Kong IPO launched at up to US$27 billion
signals.body: SHEIN launched its Hong Kong IPO seeking to raise up to US$1.8 billion at a valuation of about US$27 billion.
signals.angle: Listed-company reporting rewards connected, auditable records of the work behind each commitment.

signals.title: Everlane acquisition reported
signals.body: SHEIN was reported to be acquiring US apparel brand Everlane from L Catterton at a valuation near US$100 million.
signals.angle: Integrating a new brand runs on hundreds of cross-team tasks that belong in one shared tracker.
